# Spar 0.6.7

**The tutor can now teach an idea as a durable lesson, connect it to the challenge that practices it, and bring that lesson back when the learner needs it. This release also makes the agent thread easier to read and removes duplicated data from attempt reads without dropping any code or history.**

## Lessons you can return to

- **The tutor can create structured lessons.** Lessons are stored with their concepts and rendered as focused reading cards with pages, examples, callouts, checks, and references.
- **Lessons stay connected to practice.** A challenge on a concept the tutor already taught links back to that lesson, so the learner can reopen the explanation while applying it.
- **The tutor can search and read earlier lessons.** This lets it build on prior teaching instead of repeating the same explanation in a later turn.
- **Lesson references are durable.** Agent messages use clickable lesson links, and invalid lesson references are dropped before they can become dead links in the transcript.

## A clearer learning thread

- Challenge and lesson artifacts now have dedicated cards and readers instead of being buried in generic tool output.
- Agent activity, thoughts, system events, and completed runs have tighter grouping and clearer progression through a turn.
- The sidebar and workspace layout were refined for long sessions, while challenge metadata and step navigation expose the information needed at the point of use.
- Problem statements preserve authored structure more reliably, including links and normalized Markdown.

## Saved problems and activity

- Saved problems update immediately across the workspace and Problems page, with shared state and feedback when an item is saved.
- Agent activity survives the live to persisted handoff more reliably, including records written around turn completion.
- The tutor has stronger policy checks around teaching, question creation, and the next action after an attempt.

## Reading an attempt without duplication

- **`read_attempt` still returns the complete solve history and complete source files.** There is no automatic cap on the report, log, file count, or source length.
- Raw event payloads are no longer returned a second time after the same information has already been represented in the readable report. A compact sequence to event ID index preserves durable citations for ability evidence.
- The transcript no longer shows the internal “stored copy was cut at 16k characters” message.
